text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy 
grounds—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Should I go?! Ah, but wait...! Uuugh, what 
should I do...?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!! Trainer-san, perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
! Without mentioning it came from me, 
could you please pass something along to 
someone...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... i-it really is true~. Even if I 
delete something by mistake, I can undo 
it, and if I close it accidentally, it 
brings everything right back...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-With this, I'm sure even a klutz like me 
can manage my schedule properly...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To think such a convenient app existed...! 
Thank you so mush—much for showing it to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But it's so mysterious... It feels like 
the app developer anticipated every single 
mistake I could possibly make...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really need to send tons and tons of 
gratitude to whoever made this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Another day—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... what ought I do? I was certain I 
would hear the whisperings of the Muse in 
a place like this, yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? 'An Introduction to Modern Dance'? 
Haha, incorporating a performance that 
transcends eras could make for a splendid 
spectacle once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet another day—

text_block_list.name: Referee Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—Wait? In futsal, if the keeper throws the 
ball and it goes into the goal... does 
that count as a point? Or was it not?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't count as a goal~. Play restarts 
with an opposing goal clearance~.

text_block_list.name: Referee Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks! Wait, who was that just now—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Agnes Digital had been quietly 
supporting her fellow horse girls from the 
shadows so as not to draw attention.
choice_data_list:
(But how is she able to handle all of this 
so flawlessly...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given how deeply Agnes Digital adores 
horse girls, predicting their needs ahead 
of time might come naturally to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, possessing all the necessary 
skills and niche knowledge to pull it off 
seemed like—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hm-hmm~♪ Man, I'm so glad I went 
through all those 'experiences' 
researching futon dryers!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I was able to secretly 
drop off the replacement filter they said 
was impossible to find!
choice_data_list:
So you're always helping people from the 
shadows like that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!? W-What's the matter? So all of a 
sudden.
choice_data_list:
Because I saw how useful your 
'experiences' have been.

Because I saw how useful your 
'experiences' have been.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her programming knowledge, built with 
advice from Air Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using that, she developed a user-friendly 
schedule management app tailored for 
Meisho Doto—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And her knowledge of modern dance, learned 
from Tap Dance City, helped out TM Opera 
O.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everything she had passionately thrown 
herself into just to create her doujinshi 
had, in turn, ended up benefiting the 
horse girls around her.
choice_data_list:
Why did you feel the need to hide it, 
though?

Why did you feel the need to hide it, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Why... Well, being asked that outright is 
pretty embarrassing, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I just want the horse girls to 
live carefree lives without feeling 
obligated to mind someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Of course, whenever cheering is allowed, I 
will shout until my vocal cords wither!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
After all, nothing brings me greater bliss 
than conveying my love with everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
However, in everyday life, I want them to 
be happy and untroubled, without paying 
any mind to an otaku like me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's why lending a hand in secret is 
best. I don't want them to feel even a 
tiny shred of indebtedness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to burden the ones she holds 
dear. I couldn't help but feel pure 
admiration for Agnes Digital's selfless 
devotion.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A-Ah, I'm rambling about weird stuff, 
aren't I! Anyway, quietly working behind 
the scenes for my beloved oshi brings me 
the utmost joy, so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, AHHH?!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san, emergency! Doto-san is 
completely soaking wet over there for some 
reason!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Did she trip? Did she knock something 
over? Aaaah, forgive me, forgive me for 
finding her dejected face so ridiculously 
cute!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I gotta head over right now! I need to 
lend a helping hand without her noticing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched her sprint off with all her 
might. Her unwavering 'horse-girls-first' 
mindset filled me with immense respect.

B-But still... when someone helps us, we 
want to say thank you too...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Cease your attempts to forever 
linger as a mere spectator behind the 
curtain!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For we are endlessly grateful for your 
tireless devotion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
GYAAAH!?!? I've been busted?! WHY? 
HOW?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
There's no one else... who could have 
tracked down that replacement filter. It 
was such a rare model...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
The referee girl recognized your 
silhouette as you walked away! Thank you 
so much for the advice!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Awawawa... completely found out by my 
beloved oshi...! I'm unworthy as an 
otaku...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't say that~~. We really, 
truly appreciate everything you do for us.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaahh~~ no, stop, please don't~~! Just 
think of me as a roadside pebble and leave 
me be~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite Agnes Digital's desperate pleas, 
it seemed there was no escaping their 
heartfelt gratitude.
